en.text: Article 10 — Dividends. The official France–Czech Republic MLI-consolidated treaty text provides a 0 per cent source-State rate where the beneficial owner is a company directly holding at least 25 per cent of the payer’s capital and a 10 per cent ceiling in all other cases. The permanent-establishment or fixed-base effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise English synthesis of the official French treaty text; the official text controls.

Article 11 — Interest. The official France–Czech Republic MLI-consolidated treaty text provides residence-State-only taxation for interest beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State, subject to the permanent-establishment or fixed-base effective-connection exception and the treaty’s arm’s-length limitation. This is a concise English synthesis of the official French treaty text; the official text controls.

Article 12 — Royalties. The official France–Czech Republic MLI-consolidated treaty text provides residence-State-only taxation for copyright royalties relating to literary, artistic or scientific works other than computer software, including cinematograph films and television or radio material; a 5 per cent source-State ceiling for industrial, commercial or scientific equipment; and a 10 per cent ceiling for patents, trademarks, designs or models, plans, secret formulae or processes, computer software and know-how, where the recipient is the beneficial owner. The permanent-establishment or fixed-base effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise English synthesis of the official French treaty text; the official text controls.
